integrity: Ma–Wang Lemma 4.1 establishes the individual arithmetic-progression nongaps; their semigroup completeness, minimality and conductor are established by the included proof. scientific_limitations: Only the unique point at infinity, q>2 and even n>=4; does not derive one-point code parameters or other-point semigroups. General Kummer-semigroup equivalences in unindexed sources remain possible.
title: The complete Weierstrass semigroup at infinity of the even Ma–Wang maximal curves
